title: MTG AI: CURRENT PROGRESS
author: Mean-Committee-4035
selftext:
the boring shit first LOL: 

    - `MTGEngine` (`mtg_core/engine.py`) is the authoritative state mutator:
      - validates actions (`validate()`)
      - resolves actions (`resolve()` handlers)
      - manages priority, stack resolution, and step/turn advancement
      - exposes `get_visible_state(player_id)` as the sole read surface for AI/CLI
    - `ActionSurface` (`mtg_core/action_surface.py`) computes legality/enumerates actions using ONLY `VisibleState` (no engine mutation).
    - `Action` / `ActionType` are canonical and stable (`mtg_core/actions.py`).
    - Game model is explicit + validate-able via dataclasses (`mtg_core/game_state.py`, `mtg_core/player_state.py`, `mtg_core/cards.py`).

what that actually means for progress:

the game runs end to end, and completes on life loss or an empty library. damage resolves, my stack resolves, colored mana, empty pool on phase change, all that jazz.

now, the secret special sauce: an integrated memory that allows you to talk through your reasoning while holding priority and reason over the gamestate with the ai. this allows you to slowly train the local model with your play, ensuring that it's never outright better than you.

there is also an integrated gpt link, in case you already know what you are doing and want to jump straight to an actual opponent with memory and can play decently.
